scientific_integrity: Explicit stationary Gaussian proof and independent symbolic/numerical computational reproduction; no external scientific certification or publication-priority guarantee.
scientific_limitations: Equal coordinate-decay rates in the two thermal contacts are assumed and may require independently chosen mobilities.
Single-cycle work in the unique periodic Gaussian regime, not long-time cumulants of accumulated work.
Instantaneous stiffness jumps and no implementation cost for mobility/bath switching.
No claim for unequal relaxation rates, nonlinear potentials, or inertia.
title: A sharp cold-contact bias for reliable work extraction in a two-temperature Brownian Otto cycle
